name: background.scholar.name
editNote: Accepted: the book (p.88) offers a 4-way skill choice (Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion), with Assurance in whichever is chosen; the schema's skills array holds exactly one, so a specific pick can't be recorded without misrepresenting the other three legal options, and leaving it empty (rather than picking one arbitrarily, unlike the 2-way choices elsewhere) correctly signals that no single value is defensible here. The record's own text lists all four options and the Academia Lore skill.
